items.title: Le Drip continuano a porre domande su Gucci (e il made in Italy)
items.summary: Italian trade outlet LaConceria argues Gucci's China-made 'Drip' sneaker (part of Demna's Primavera line) raises a brand-identity problem for Kering's flagship house and casts doubt on the future of Italian footwear manufacturing, framing the cost-efficiency choice as a risky precedent for luxury provenance.

items.title: Le sneaker Gucci made in China sono un problema politico
items.summary: Italian daily Il Foglio frames Gucci's decision to produce its new 800-euro Drip sneaker in China as evidence of a structural gap in Italian manufacturing competitiveness, invoking Patrizio Bertelli's old 'made in Prada' line and calling for industrial-policy attention to how 'Made in Italy' is defined and supported.

items.title: Gucci rompe il dogma del 'made in Italy': la prima sneaker di Demna e prodotta in Cina
items.summary: Pambianco reports Gucci broke with its all-Italian production tradition by manufacturing Demna's debut sneaker in China, noting the brand says it chose the Chinese partner for technical capability reasons while stressing Italy remains central to its identity.

items.title: Gucci's new 'Made in China' sneaker models break with Italian tradition
items.summary: Reuters wire story reports Gucci has begun selling sneaker models labelled 'Made in China,' breaking Italian manufacturing tradition as it chases middle-class shoppers; Berenberg analysts warn of tension between provenance and luxury positioning, and a Milan consultant calls the move 'not a good look.'

items.title: Demna opens up shop for 'quintessentially Gucci' sophomore show
items.summary: Review of Demna's second Milan runway show ('The Store Show'), staged as a retail-concept set that previews Gucci's renovated store design; confirms the first renovated boutique on Avenue Montaigne, Paris opens late October as part of the retail overhaul, following months of uncertainty over whether Gucci would renew that lease at all.

items.title: A Milan, Demna, chez Gucci, mele aristocratie et culture pop
items.summary: French trade press review of Demna's Milan Fashion Week show mixing aristocratic references and pop culture; describes hooded tailoring, tartan linings and rock-and-roll styling as Demna pursues his 'complete personal vision' for Gucci to revive growth.

items.title: Demna Calls on Tom Brady, Xiao Zhan, Ningning, Shawn Mendes and More for Gucci Primavera Campaign
items.summary: WWD reports Gucci's Primavera campaign features ten celebrity faces spanning sport, music and film; Demna describes the campaign concept as 'emotional awakening' built like a music video, continuing the brand's heavy reliance on star-power marketing.

items.title: Kering shares slide after Gucci sales disappoint
items.summary: FashionNetwork reports Kering shares fell after Gucci posted an 8% sales decline, marking an eleventh straight quarterly drop, even as CEO Luca de Meo pointed to early signs of recovery under Demna's new direction.

items.source: X (Twitter) - general public reaction, aggregated via press coverage
items.title: Public social reaction to Gucci's 'Made in China' Drip sneaker
items.summary: Coverage of the Drip sneaker story notes widespread social-media and industry commentary questioning why an 800-euro Gucci sneaker should carry a China label; sentiment skews skeptical, with claims the label undercuts the craftsmanship premium buyers are paying for.

items.source: Weibo (via Sina finance republish, discussing Gucci pricing globally)
items.title: Gucci涨价规律彻底变了？十年翻倍到2026踩刹车 (Gucci's price-hike pattern has stalled)
items.summary: Social/finance commentary circulating on Weibo-linked channels notes Gucci reversed a decade-long pattern of annual price increases, cutting prices on some classic styles by up to 40% in 2026 after Kering's CEO admitted products had been 'overpriced,' discussion framed around resale-value and buy-now-or-wait consumer debate.

items.title: Gucci customer reviews flag quality complaints
items.summary: Recent Trustpilot reviews describe quality issues on recent purchases, including a shawl that pilled within a month and a belt whose loop broke after four wears; reviewers call the defects 'shameful' for a luxury-priced product, continuing a thread of quality-decline complaints.

items.source: TikTok (aggregated creator commentary via nssmagazine and others)
items.title: TikTok creator buildup/reaction to Demna's Milan Gucci show
items.summary: nss magazine's TikTok post hyping Demna's upcoming Milan runway show drew creator engagement and anticipation comments; broader TikTok discovery pages show a mix of fan excitement and skeptical 'gimmick over clothes' reaction videos dissecting the Store Show concept.

items.title: Gucci reshuffles EMEA leadership; Kering sells Milan building stake to Qatari buyer
items.summary: FashionNetwork UK's Gucci tracker reports Maria Cristina Lomanto named president EMEA in a management reshuffle, alongside Kering's $1.4bn sale of a majority stake in a Milan building to a Qatari investor as the group raises cash amid its restructuring drive.
